Name: Home Barista
Author: bluebellfairy01
Description:
Features include:

[list]
[*]New item called 'Roast Coffee' that can be purchased or made yourself by placing 10 coffee beans into a furnace.
[*]Espresso machine (now available at JojaMart and the Stardroop Saloon) that uses 'Roast Coffee' to make 'Triple Shot Espresso'. It will pull them from your fridge if you have none on you. Also you can hit it with hardwood to change the table under it.
[*]Coffee mug drinking sprites!
[*]Plus a handful of new coffee-based recipes for you to discover!
[*]AND MUCH MUCH MORE!
[/list]
(Well maybe not that much more.)

Multiplayer may work but each player must have a local copy of the mod files.

Requires SMAPI.
